answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using transitive trust graphs. Peer attestations branch like an intertwined vine from seed nodes, sustaining a verifiable oasis of reputable peers. Reputation scores radiate like a layered lotus, decaying across graph distance to isolate spoofed clusters. An attacker incurs the scarce cost of cultivating organic social capital from honest nodes per identity. However, this framework penalizes legitimate newcomers who lack pre-existing endorsements.
